settingsNotificationsText: With “Not today”, “Call” and “WhatsApp” right in the notification.
settingsCountryCodeText: For numbers without a country code, e.g. 0171 …
settingsDiscreetText: Widget and watch show initials instead of names.
settingsPrivacyText: All data stays encrypted on this device. No account, no cloud, no internet permission, no analytics. From the address book the app only takes name and number, and only when you ask. It does not detect calls by itself – it counts what you tap or log in the app.
backupIntro: Backup: all your data, encrypted in one file – for a new phone or just in case. It cannot be read without the password.
backupPassphraseCreateHint: Choose a password for the backup. It cannot be restored without it – keep it safe!
backupRestoreConfirmText: All contacts, the history and the settings on this device will be replaced by the backup.
backupTooNew: This backup is from a newer app version. Please update the app.
backupWrongApp: This is not a Ruf durch backup.
notificationBodyNew: Today would be a good day for it.
notificationBodySince: {count, plural, =1{You were last in touch yesterday.} other{You were last in touch {count} days ago.}}
notificationChannelDescription: One contact a day you could get in touch with.
